notes: has_mva is true: the product page says the surrender value reflects price changes of the underlying assets (市場価格調整; explainer video on the product page) and applies a 解約控除率. The MVA formula and any published MVA rate are not collected.

The rate page shows only the current half-month 積立利率設定期間 and is overwritten on the 1st and 16th; history accumulates only by re-running scripts/tdf.py (plus the few Wayback captures, see rate_series history).
effective_date is the first day of the 積立利率設定期間. 積立利率 (crediting_rate) and 実質的な利回り (net_yield) share the same grid.

The page's 契約年齢 column is the eligible contract-age range (JPY 40-90 for 5y, 40-85 for 10y; FX no rider 40-93/90/85 for 2/5/10y; with 保険金最低保証特約 40-83/80/75), not a rate dimension, so age_band is blank. Age ranges are not stored in the CSVs.

Net-yield tables are headed 男性・女性 (one figure for both sexes), so sex is blank. Net yield is truncated to 2 decimals by the insurer; FX net yield assumes an FX change rate of 100% over the deferral period.
Rate page text 積立利率は…基準金利に最大1.5％を増減させた範囲内で決定 (rate = reference rate +/- up to 1.5%). Reference rates: JGB yield (JPY), USD bond index yield (USD), plus AUD/USD swap and basis spreads (AUD).
Rates can show 取扱停止中 (plan temporarily not offered); the collector records these as status not_offered.
The ご契約のしおり・約款 flipbook (clause/index.html) serves per-page images only; the whole-document PDF is /weby/pdf/260191.pdf, linked from the product page.

Wayback holds 4 distinct captures of the rate page (2024-12-08, 2025-10-09, 2026-05-18, 2026-06-05) and 4 of its distributor copy r_tumitate_riritu.html (2025-08-09, 2026-01-17, 2026-05-18, 2026-06-05; the last two repeat periods already on file and match them value for value). Together: 6 Wayback periods (2024-12-01, 2025-08-01, 2025-10-01, 2026-01-16, 2026-05-16, 2026-06-01) plus live 2026-11-16. No data before 2024-12-01 and none for periods between captures (checked 2026-11-17, CDX prefix search of /fiveten_world4/).
Distributor list is the 金融機関等代理店 list on the product's 募集代理店 page; プランのお取扱は募集代理店により異なる場合があります。 Bank-specific product names (white labels) not collected.

Launch date: 2024-10-01, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2024-09-30 (25 institutions; 『ファイブテン・ワールド４』, announced 2024-09-25, snapshot sources/tdf/pages/release_20240925_2026-11-17.pdf). It renews 『ファイブテン・ワールド３』 (from 2023-03), which renewed 『ファイブテン・ワールド２』 (from 2019-09), which renewed 『ファイブテン・ワールド』 (from 2017-11-28, the first); the date here is for edition 4, whose formal names differ. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: The insurer overwrites its rate page each half-month, so history before 16 November 2026 is four archive captures only.
One product name covers the yen plan (two courses) and the foreign-currency plan (with and without the guarantee rider).
The foreign-currency plan also has a 2-year term.
Launched 1 October 2024 (insurer news release); it renews earlier Five Ten World editions.

verification.method: Rows retrieved through 2026-11-16: every rate row was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser. The 64 rows retrieved on 2026-11-17: an independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 20 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 20 of 64 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (0: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (0). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
